name: Ali Hazelwood
bio: Ali Hazelwood writes contemporary romance featuring smart, ambitious women, academic settings, and lovable characters. Her stories often explore STEM careers, relationships, and workplace romance.

name: Haruki Murakami
bio: Haruki Murakami is a Japanese novelist known for blending ordinary life with surrealism, dreamlike settings, loneliness, memory, and magical realism.

name: Ana Huang
bio: Ana Huang is a contemporary romance author known for emotionally intense relationships, charismatic characters, and interconnected romance series.

name: Fyodor Dostoevsky
bio: Fyodor Dostoevsky was a Russian novelist whose influential works explore human psychology, morality, faith, suffering, freedom, and existential questions.

name: Albert Camus
bio: Albert Camus was a French-Algerian writer and philosopher associated with absurdism. His works explore the human condition, meaning, freedom, and the search for purpose.

name: Franz Kafka
bio: Franz Kafka was a German-speaking Bohemian writer known for unsettling, surreal stories exploring alienation, bureaucracy, anxiety, and the absurdity of human existence.

name: Emily Henry
bio: Emily Henry is a contemporary romance and fiction author known for witty dialogue, emotional storytelling, memorable characters, and heartfelt relationships.

name: J.R.R. Tolkien
bio: English writer and philologist best known for creating Middle-earth and influential works of fantasy.

name: Agatha Christie
bio: English crime novelist celebrated for intricate mysteries and iconic detectives.

name: James Clear
bio: Author and speaker known for writing about habits, decision-making and continuous improvement.
